title: Michael’s Last Dundies
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael prepares for his final Dundies event, going house to house to give nominations, practicing hosting with DeAngelo, and reflecting on the significance of the event. The episode features the Dundies ceremony, character interactions, conflicts, and moments of celebration, culminating in Michael's reflection on his legacy and the show's future.

main_threads.thread: Michael's preparations and reflections on the Dundies event

evidence.snippet: Michael: It is six a.m. and we are about to go house to house to give everyone their Dundie Nomination Certificates.
Stanley: Have you lost your mind! Get off my property before I call the police!
Meredith: Ahh, Nice! I got a Dundie nomination!
Michael: Yes you did. That's right! Congratulations Meredith.
Michael: The Dundies are my baby, and they need to go on.
Michael: So as you know, the Dundies are my legacy. So I'm going to need to train a replacement. So this year, I have decided to have a co-host. And that person is DeAngelo!
